title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 213 William Hilton Parkway in Hilton Head Island, South Carolina, as the "Caesar H. Wright Jr. Post Office Building".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 213 William Hilton Parkway in Hilton Head Island, South Carolina, as the Caesar H. Wright Jr. Post Office Building.

summary.headline: Renames a Postal Service building in Hilton Head Island, South Carolina, after Caesar H. Wright Jr.
summary.what_it_does: This law names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 213 William Hilton Parkway in Hilton Head Island, South Carolina, the Caesar H. Wright Jr. Post Office Building. It is a naming measure only and does not change how the post office operates or what services it offers.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 27, 2022, and the designation applies from that date.
